primary_base: Beacon_A1 / v4.5A BLACKBOX HOME CORTEX POLISH
late_donor: ADV Elite Zero v0.20 SKY ANCHOR

mission.goal: self-learning predictive AI that exchanges telemetry with the swarm, learns from real sensor and swarm logs, predicts future environmental/swarm state, and is judged by decreasing future holdout prediction error

m2r.role: generate and score plausible future-state trajectories from real state + known/empirical physics + uncertainty
m2r.time_reference: authoritative disciplined time axis for forecast/reality alignment
m2r.active_gate_semantics: entering 1488 activates bounded multi-scenario future simulation and forecast-learning loop
m2r.tachyon_guard: Tachyon is an architecture/persona metaphor, not evidence of literal faster-than-light behavior

fixed_truth_rules: real sensor/log inputs remain distinguishable from model-derived features
training loss alone is not evidence of improved prediction
future holdout and naive baselines are required
failed predictions and negative experiments are preserved

resolved_questions.Q02: M2R=physics-informed forward World Model; authoritative time axis aligns forecast with realized future; adaptive temporal resolution is subordinate
resolved_questions.Q03: 1488 activates M2R active future-simulation mode; passive Tachyon temporal continuity may remain outside active mode
